_note: DOSE spec story ad: the single source of truth for picture and sound (read by the page, tools/prep.py, tools/conform.py and audio.py). Seconds. 100 BPM: 1 beat = 0.6 s = 18 frames @30 fps; the music's bar 1 lands on the first dose (1.8 s). Cuts: 1.8 (no cut: the hook's frozen, grey, defocused grinders come alive), 4.2, 6.6 (bar lines), 8.4, 10.2 (half bars: the montage tightens 4-4-3-3 beats), 12.6 the graphic match from the wall sign to the end card, 15.3 the TASH tail.

shots.name: HOOK: mood battery at 15%, blinking; the world is grey and out of focus
dose 1: grinders, the origin cards print on (d1)
dose 2: iced filter, ice tumbles out of the carafe with the coffee (d2d)
dose 3: espresso into iced milk (d3 part A)
dose 4: the cake, milky coffee sauce (d4)
100%: the terrace, crane up from the tray to the dose sign (d5b, sign replaced with the real mark)
END CARD: graphic match, the wall sign becomes the mark on white plaster; Al Jahra + @sdosecafe

footage._note: keys: [[edit_t, source_s], ...]; source clips are 24 fps, 121 frames (5.04 s). 2 keys: linear; 3+: monotone cubic. modes: blend = linear blend of the two nearest source frames; adaptive = that blend where the picture is slow, the nearest frame where it moves fast (MOR/HABBA tool); nearest = the nearest source frame (24p cadence in 30p; d2d: transparent ice and the stream must never be shown double). Ranges are the CD reviews' clean ranges.

segs.why: hook: frame 0 held (grey, dark, defocused in the page) under the low battery; from the first dose the slider move runs 0.00-3.00 s at exactly 1.25x, so every edit frame is one whole source frame (no blend: the printed card names never double); the clip's own near-static first 0.75 s eases the start. Grinder 2's invented rating plate (source y >= 1745) is kept out by a top-anchored >= 1.12x frame; grinder 3's plate starts at 3.5 s (unused). Card 1 leaves frame right from 2.54 s, as the camera passes it

1.0x inside the best range 1.54-3.96 (f37.6-f94.4): ice slides over the spout with the coffee and tumbles into the cup; nearest-frame 24p cadence with the repeats on f4k+2 (the model's double step is f4k-1 -> f4k, so a hold never touches it); cut before the f100 pile pop; «specialty» re-comped (tools/fx_specialty.py)
part A only (the clip has a hard cut at 1.958 s): 0.117-1.917 s at 1.0x, last blend pair 45/46; the pitcher pour and the whole wordmark above the reply bar
the only clean range f0-f36 (one square cake; the cake splits from f38), 0.83x

from 2.30 s: the espresso steam is gone by 2.2 s (owner: espresso never steams); the tray, the crane up, the rack focus onto the sign at 3.6-4.0 s, sharp sign to the end; 1.0x real speed; adaptive blend (the near cups move ~15 px a frame: shown as whole frames, never double; the slow background is blended); the sign is replaced with dose's real mark (tools/fx_sign.py); runs 0.3 s under the end card's dissolve
